articles.title: Russia’s Sber eyes USDT loans, questions digital ruble demand
articles.description: Russia’s largest bank, Sber, plans to accept USDT and Ether alongside Bitcoin as loan collateral as the country introduces regulated crypto trading under a new law.

articles.title: Real Trump Coins denies launching GOLD token, blames ‘bad actors’
articles.description: Trump-linked Real Trump Coins said it never authorized GOLD or any digital token as questions persisted over its X account, associated domains and the concentrated token supply.

articles.title: Polygon discloses security flaws fixed in recent hard forks
articles.description: The vulnerabilities posed denial-of-service and validator resource risks but were patched before Polygon publicly disclosed them.

articles.title: Stellar tokenized RWA market more than quadruples to nearly $4B
articles.description: Stellar’s real-world asset market has expanded rapidly this year as institutional adoption and tokenization activity grow across the network.

articles.title: Tokenized stock transfer volume jumps 415% in 30 days to $29.5B
articles.description: Tokenized equities saw a sharp rise in onchain activity as active addresses and holders more than doubled over the past month.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Trump-promoted brand touts GOLD before token collapse
articles.description: Real Trump Coins promoted GOLD before deleting related X posts, while team-linked wallets sold 224.5 million tokens as its market value fell about 99%.

articles.title: Stablecoins not credible for payments at scale, BIS chief says
articles.description: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos said stablecoins lack credibility for payments at scale, while a new FSI study highlights sharp differences in issuer rules.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs end 9-day inflow streak as BTC dips below $78K
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $201.8 million in net outflows Friday, led by ARK 21Shares, as total fund assets slipped back below $100 billion.

articles.title: Solana validators approve proposal to accelerate SOL disinflation
articles.description: The approved proposal doubles Solana’s annual disinflation rate from 15% to 30%, reducing future SOL issuance while leaving its long-term inflation target unchanged.

articles.title: Chelsea FC gets a stablecoin sponsor after UK FCA warning to clubs
articles.description: According to Circle, the USDC stablecoin name will appear on the front of club jerseys for Chelsea’s upcoming football season.

articles.title: Bullish provides USD.AI $100M stablecoin facility for GPU-backed lending
articles.description: The institutional crypto exchange is providing $100 million in stablecoin liquidity to support loans backed by AI computing infrastructure.

articles.title: Bitcoin dips to $78.4K as Fed’s Warsh downplays softer inflation prints
articles.description: Bitcoin failed to make a decisive break above $80,000 as traders digested Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole keynote speech, which remained wary of US inflation trends.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin pumps, Wall Street does the paperwork
articles.description: Bitcoin’s $80,000 rebound lifts crypto stocks as Circle, Strategy and Solana show how capital markets, stablecoins and onchain growth are driving crypto’s recovery.

articles.title: Who is legally liable when an AI agent goes rogue?
articles.description: If your personal AI agent goes rogue and causes harm or financial damage in the real world, can you be held liable?

articles.title: Polish Olympic chief charged in Zondacrypto probe, justice minister says
articles.description: Polish Olympic Committee president Radosław Piesiewicz faces charges as prosecutors investigate his ties to collapsed cryptocurrency exchange Zondacrypto.

articles.title: California Senate passes bill to ban memecoin issuance by public officials
articles.description: The bill seeks to prohibit the listing of memecoins issued by federal public officials to California residents, citing conflicts of interest and “pay-to-play arrangements.”

articles.title: Capital B raises $24.5M for its Bitcoin treasury amid market uncertainty with BlockStream’s Adam Back chipping in
articles.description: The French Bitcoin treasury firm’s private placement drew support from Adam Back and TOBAM, with warrant exercises potentially unlocking another $158 million.

articles.title: Bitcoin bear market ‘over’ as price metric copies 2023 recovery: CryptoQuant CEO
articles.description: Bitcoin profitability data produced a bear-market reversal signal that was also present at the start of 2023.

articles.title: ENA token rises 10% as Ethena puts revenue-funded token buybacks to vote
articles.description: The Ethena Foundation proposed buying the token supply held by major early investors and revealed a fee switch to turn 95% of net protocol revenue into ENA buybacks.

articles.title: BitGo buys NYDIG trading arm to deepen institutional crypto push
articles.description: BitGo completed its acquisition of NYDIG’s institutional trading business, adding about 30 employees and expanding its derivatives and financing capabilities.

articles.title: OneKey reproduces transaction replacement attack on outdated Ledger Ethereum app
articles.description: OneKey said it reproduced an exploit against an older version of the Ledger app in its lab environment, which Ledger fixed in its Ethereum app 1.22.2, with no user funds lost.

articles.title: Visa works with Upbit parent on stablecoin payments, AI commerce
articles.description: Visa and Dunamu will explore stablecoin payments and remittances, with Open Standard’s proposed OUSD among several projects under review.

articles.title: The Sandbox pledges 1:1 repayment after $700K bridge exploit
articles.description: Eligible holders on Base and BNB Chain will receive Ethereum-based SAND from the project’s treasury, with claims expected to open within two weeks.

articles.title: Abu Dhabi royal backs 49% stake in Trump-linked crypto bank venture: WSJ
articles.description: Sheikh Tahnoon’s group reportedly backs a 49% stake in the holding company behind World Liberty’s conditionally approved US trust bank.

articles.title: Virtu, Tradeweb complete onchain repo using Marshall Islands digital bond
articles.description: The transaction used the Marshall Islands-issued USDM1 bond as collateral and completed the full repo cycle on the Canton Network in under 10 minutes.

articles.title: Trump cost investors $4.7B through crypto ‘schemes’: Public Citizen
articles.description: While investors in World Liberty Financial‘s USD1 stablecoin “haven’t suffered major losses,” many lost billions of dollars in other Trump ventures, according to Public Citizen.

articles.title: Mirae Asset lays out crypto, stablecoin, tokenization plans for Digital X
articles.description: The South Korean financial group plans to build a $109 billion digital asset business spanning crypto, stablecoins and tokenized assets, according to The Korea Times.

articles.title: Grayscale says Zcash can challenge Bitcoin’s network effects as privacy demand grows
articles.description: ZEC has climbed roughly 19-fold in a year, yet Grayscale says its sub-1% share of Bitcoin’s market cap leaves room for further upside.

articles.title: Bitcoin eyes $81K as Nvidia earnings beat boosts risk assets
articles.description: Bitcoin and crypto joined US stock markets in fresh gains after Nvidia Q2 earnings beat expectations by around $4 billion.
